# Sample public peer list

* Frankfurt, example
  * `tls://alpha.example:443`
  * `tcp://alpha.example:80`

* Nuremberg, pinned
  * `tls://beta.example:1338?key=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
  * `quic://beta.example:1339?key=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`

* Ignore this scheme
  * `https://example.com/not-a-peer`
